test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

Zebras are categorised as stocky wild horses. These mostly ______ on grass. Zebras are mostly found in the open plains or in lightly wooded areas in the east and south of the African continent. The zebra’s stripes are broken up with an ______ outline making it very difficult to spot them against a background of tall grass.
solution:
The correct answer is **"feed; effective."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first blank needs a word which means to give food.
 
• **"Feed"** is a verb that means to give food to someone or something. ((मनुष्‍य या पशु को) खिलाना, भोजन देना)
 
 
• **Example**: *Don’t forget to **feed**__ the dog.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about what zebras mostly do, so the appropriate verb to use is **"feed."**
 
• The second blank needs a word which is close to impactful.
 
• **"Effective"** is an adjective that describes something that produces the desired result
